Local symbols: $J^{\mathrm{d}}_{i+1/2}$ is the already time-integrated implicit dry-air transfer through a face
[$\mathrm{kg}$], positive toward increasing $x_1$; $J^{\mathrm{tr}}_{n,i+1/2}$ is its upwind passive-tracer transfer [$\mathrm{kg}$].
Here $n$ labels a passive tracer and $r_n$ is its dimensionless ratio per dry mass. Superscripts
$\mathrm{base}$ and $\mathrm{entry}$ distinguish the source-free stage and source-entry state; $\mathrm{carry}$ denotes the selected carry ratio and $\mathrm{source}$ a source increment.
These transfer symbols are proposed in the @sec-ch01 item in `ISSUES.md`.

### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** `advance_local` publishes the stage, saves the step-start state on stage zero, assembles the hydro and scalar increments, applies user increments, combines the stage and enforces the conserved limiter (@eq-ch01-stage-weight, @eq-ch01-stage-transfer, @eq-ch01-stage-dry).
**Data.** In: the conserved cell averages `hydro_u` and the scalar rows ($\rho_{\mathrm d}$, $\rho_n$ [kg m$^{-3}$], $m_a$ [kg m$^{-2}$ s$^{-1}$], $E$ [J m$^{-3}$]; passive scalars as densities [kg m$^{-3}$], ratios per unit dry mass), the stage weights $w^{(s)}_0, w^{(s)}_1, w^{(s)}_2$ [-] and any installed increments in the same units per stage. Out: the stage-combined state in the same rows, interior cells; last-stage thermodynamic adjustment and the gravity-work fixer precede the final physical boundary fill.
**Placement.** Once per RK stage, inside the block's advance.
**Activation.** User increments only when callbacks are installed (`user_stage_forcings`); the integrator stages are external.
**Guarantee / limits.** The combine is an affine recurrence in the stage weights, exact in arithmetic; no spatial order applies.
**Evidence.** `test_user_output.release` asserts the ordered hydro/scalar increments (rtol = atol = $10^{-12}$) and that a shared callback works and bad keys throw; `test_jit_user_forcing_python` asserts a nested scripted module's increment (`assert_close` defaults); no run of these ctest entries is recorded for this chapter at the pin (missing evidence). `stage_check.py` `[C1]`-`[C3]` is report-only, run with its committed output `src/snapy_report/ch01/stage_check.out`.
:::

`advance_local` publishes the stage, saves the initial state on stage zero, assembles hydro and scalar increments,
applies user increments, combines the stage and enforces the conserved limiter. Last-stage thermodynamic adjustment
and the gravity-work fixer precede the final physical boundary fill.

### Derivation

The fields in this section are cell averages. The conserved vector $\mathbf U$ contains densities,
momentum densities and energy density with the component units of the notation table; $\Delta t$ is in seconds.


Write $\Delta\mathbf U$ for the supplied stage increment, with the units of the corresponding conserved
component. The source comment states the combine as an in-place affine recurrence:

$$
\mathbf U \leftarrow w_0^{(s)}\mathbf U^n + w_1^{(s)}\mathbf U + w_2^{(s)}\Delta\mathbf U.
$$ {#eq-ch01-stage-combine}

@eq-ch01-stage-combine is the recurrence stated beside `cw` in
{{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}.
The increment here includes whichever explicit and implicit operations were selected; it is not restricted to
the notation table's explicit increment $\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}$.

Consider a fixed supplied
increment in stage $(s)$, while holding later increments fixed. It enters the combination with coefficient
$w_2^{(s)}$. The next combine multiplies this contribution by $w_1^{(s+1)}$; the saved initial state contributes
no copy of this new increment. Repeating this substitution through each later stage gives the final coefficient

$$
w_2^{(s)}\prod_{s'>s}w_1^{(s')}.
$$ {#eq-ch01-stage-weight}

@eq-ch01-stage-weight is the coefficient `cw` accumulated in {{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}.
The product is over the remaining stages; an empty product is one. This identity is exact for the bookkeeping
of supplied increments, not a linearization of their nonlinear state dependence. The combine call `pintg`
is at {{< code src/mesh/meshblock.cpp MeshBlockImpl::advance_local >}}; the actual integrator coefficients are external, so this chapter does not assert them
from a snapy call site. Check `[C1]` expands a generic three-stage affine recurrence symbolically.

The tracer transfer and its dry-source complement are derived in @sec-ch10-tracer; this section keeps only the call
interface and the three identities the code evaluates. The transfer of tracer $n$ through an $x_1$ face is the
clamped dry transfer $J^{\mathrm{d}}$ of the implicit mass-correction buffer times the ratio of the donor cell,

$$
J^{\mathrm{tr}}_{n,i+1/2} = J^{\mathrm{d}}_{i+1/2}
\begin{cases}
r_{n,i}, & J^{\mathrm{d}}_{i+1/2}>0,\\
r_{n,i+1}, & J^{\mathrm{d}}_{i+1/2}\le 0,
\end{cases}
$$ {#eq-ch01-stage-upwind}

the upwind `P` of {{< code src/mesh/meshblock.cpp MeshBlockImpl::advance_local >}}; the increment of a cell is the net
transfer over its volume $V_i$ [$\mathrm{m^3}$],

$$
\Delta\rho_{n,i} = \frac{J^{\mathrm{tr}}_{n,i-1/2}-J^{\mathrm{tr}}_{n,i+1/2}}{V_i},
$$ {#eq-ch01-stage-transfer}

the `P - P_above` update of the same function; and a supplied dry-mass source carries the tracers at the selected
carry ratio $r^{\mathrm{carry}}_n$ (dimensionless),

$$
\Delta\rho^{\mathrm{source}}_n = r^{\mathrm{carry}}_n
\Delta\rho^{\mathrm{source}}_{\mathrm{d}},
$$ {#eq-ch01-stage-dry}

`carry_dry_source` in {{< code src/mesh/meshblock.cpp MeshBlockImpl::advance_local >}}. Checks `[C2]` and `[C3]` of
`src/snapy_report/ch01/stage_check.py` exercise the two identities on a port, with the committed output
`src/snapy_report/ch01/stage_check.out`; they import no snapy.

### Numerical method

The hydro call returns a time-integrated increment. Scalar transport then uses the hydro dry-mass flux and the
implicit dry-mass transfer. Native dry sources carry tracers before callbacks; user dry sources carry tracers after
all callbacks, using the saved pre-callback scalar increment. The callback result accepts only `hydro_du` and
`scalar_ds` with matching shapes. Solids are refilled after the RK combine. Saturation adjustment is restricted to
interior cells, the last stage and a nonempty reaction list. This map asserts algebraic identities, not an observed
convergence order at walls or seams.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
The stage algebra does not prove positivity after arbitrary user increments, nor accuracy after nonlinear
limiting or phase adjustment. Switch combinations remain subject to @sec-ch12-matrix; no new CPU, CUDA or multi-rank
snapy run is claimed.
:::
